string.name: confirm_risk
string.value: Steam flagged this request for unusual location or frequency

string.name: confirm_notice
string.value: Approve only requests you initiated when the device, location, and action all match your expectations.

string.name: confirm_history_note
string.value: Only successful actions on this device are stored, up to 100 entries.

string.name: steam_session_description
string.value: The Refresh Token controls the session lifetime. An expired Access Token can usually be refreshed directly.

string.name: steam_guard_data_note
string.value: MobileApp login normally does not return this field. Not configured is expected and does not affect codes, confirmations, or session refresh.

string.name: steam_reauthenticate_note
string.value: The password is used only for this login and is never saved. The current token submits its Steam Guard code automatically. Optional Guard Data returned by Steam is encrypted for compatible future logins.

string.name: steam_relogin
string.value: Sign in again and update session

string.name: settings_subtitle
string.value: Icon packs, secure storage, and backups

string.name: settings_icon_hint
string.value: Automatic matching uses only the active pack. Hold an icon on the home screen to choose from any installed icon.

string.name: settings_default_icon_hint
string.value: Always available when no image matches

string.name: settings_backup_hint
string.value: Backups include OTP secrets and Steam session data and can only be decrypted with the password you set.

string.name: settings_restore_rule
string.value: Tokens with the same UUID are updated; different UUIDs are added.

string.name: settings_screenshot_hint
string.value: When enabled, screenshots, screen recordings, and recent-task previews hide app content. This setting is restored on next launch.

string.name: settings_logs_hint
string.value: Useful for reporting Steam, backup, icon pack, and persistence issues. Sensitive credentials are redacted automatically. Up to about 768 KB is retained.

string.name: settings_local_protection_hint
string.value: Token data is encrypted with a system-protected master key and AES-256-GCM. System automatic backup is disabled.

string.name: add_subtitle
string.value: Choose the method that works best for you

string.name: add_scan_description
string.value: Scan the authentication QR code shown by a website, or choose a QR image from your gallery.

string.name: add_scan_hint
string.value: Supports standard TOTP and Steam Guard QR codes. Unrecognized content is kept on the URI tab for review.

string.name: add_uri_description
string.value: Paste an otpauth:// link. Common escaping, quotes, and surrounding text are cleaned automatically.

string.name: add_steam_detected
string.value: Issuer is Steam. A five-character Steam Guard code with a 30-second period will be used automatically.

string.name: add_period_hint
string.value: Allowed range: 1–300 seconds. It must match the period supplied by the service.

string.name: add_steam_title
string.value: Sign in and add Steam Guard

string.name: add_steam_description
string.value: This flow creates a new mobile authenticator for your Steam account and saves its secret and session metadata after verification.

string.name: add_steam_existing_hint
string.value: If a mobile Steam Guard is already attached, Steam may require a transfer first. This cannot retrieve the existing secret from the server.

string.name: add_steam_activation_prompt
string.value: Steam sign-in is complete. Verify the new mobile authenticator to finish.

string.name: add_steam_transfer_warning
string.value: Continuing creates a new secret and disables Steam Guard on the previous phone or authenticator. Make sure you can receive SMS on the account phone number.

string.name: add_steam_have_sms
string.value: I already have the SMS code

string.name: add_steam_sms_title
string.value: Enter the SMS code to complete transfer

string.name: add_password_note
string.value: The password is used only for this RSA-encrypted login and is never written to the token, backup, or local storage.

string.name: steam_server_status_note
string.value: These fields are returned directly by Steam's QueryStatus API.

string.name: steam_revoke_note
string.value: Revoking removes the mobile authenticator from the Steam account and disables local codes and confirmations.

string.name: steam_repair_note
string.value: Only identifiable fields can be repaired here. Update Access Token, Refresh Token, and secrets by signing in again or importing data.

string.value: Enter the code Steam sent to your email

string.name: steam_prompt_device_code

string.name: steam_prompt_device_confirmation
string.value: Approve the sign-in in the Steam mobile app, then return here

string.name: steam_prompt_email_confirmation
string.value: Open the confirmation link in Steam's email, then return here

string.name: steam_enter_activation
string.value: Enter the Steam Guard activation code

string.name: steam_requesting_transfer
string.value: Requesting transfer of the existing Steam Guard…

string.value: Steam started the recovery. The recovery email is not the code; wait for the SMS sent to the account phone number, then complete the transfer.

string.value: Enter the Steam transfer SMS code you received earlier

string.value: Logs contain app operations, errors, and network status. Sensitive credentials are redacted automatically, but you should still review the file before sharing.
